test_map_nested: test py_utils.map_nested to apply a function recursively to each element of a nested data structure
test_zip_nested: test py_utils.zip_nested to zip multiple nested data structures together preserving their shape
test_flatten_nest_dict: test py_utils.flatten_nest_dict and pack_as_nest_dict to flatten and reconstruct nested dicts with slash-separated keys
test_flatten_with_path: test py_utils.flatten_with_path to convert a nested structure into a flat list of path-value tuples
test_incomplete_file: test py_utils.incomplete_file context manager for atomic file writes via temp file and rename
